image-classification.title: MobileNet - Image classification
image-classification.name: MobileNet - Image Classifier
image-classification.summary: All kinds of photos: MobileNet V2, pre-trained on ImageNet, recognises a thousand categories of animals, objects and food.

text: MobileNet V2 is a family of neural networks for the classification of similar images and tasks.
This model is able to differentiate between 1001 categories, identifying the main context of the image.

sections.title: Input data
items: Image with color values between [0, 1] of 224 x 224 pixels.

sections.title: Output data
items: A number of 0 to 1001 that are each of the categories of this <link2> list </link2>

sections.title: References
text: Originally it was published by Mark Sandler, Andrew Howard, Menglong Zhu, Andrey Zhmoginov, Liang-Chieh Chen:
items: <link3>Inverted Residuals and Linear Bottlenecks: Mobile Networks for Classification, Detection and Segmentation</link3> 2018
<link1>ImageNet</link1>: the dataset it was trained with. It is not in the package: it has over a million photos.
